bio.text: Norma Torres has represented California's 35th Congressional District in the U.S. House since January 2015.
She immigrated to the United States from Guatemala and worked as a 911 dispatcher for the Los Angeles Police Department for 17 years.
She served on the Pomona City Council from 2000 to 2006 and as mayor from 2006 to 2008, and later served in the California State Assembly and State Senate.
She earned a bachelor's degree in labor studies from the National Labor College and lives in Pomona; she is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
